description: This file defines the PimReport class within the OrangeHRM PIM Report module. It implements report generation logic, including retrieving header and filter definitions, preparing filter parameters, validating access permissions, and managing report data related to PIM reports.

classes.name: PimReport
classes.description: Implements EndpointAwareReport, providing functionalities to generate and validate PIM reports, manage filter parameters, and enforce report access permissions.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy initialization of the ReportGeneratorService instance used to generate report data.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the header definition for the report based on report ID.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Provides an empty Filter object; can be customized to define report filters.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Constructs and returns a PimReportData object using provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates PimReportSearchFilterParams with request parameters, including report ID, and sets sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for request parameters, mainly for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the report requested is 'pim_defined'; throws ForbiddenException if not, enforcing access control.
